description: MCP tool call metrics, error rates, duration, request/response sizes, deployment statuses, and traces for the Archestra platform

options.content: Select the deployment job and tool filters. Totals and weighted averages use the selected time range; rates use the scrape-aware interval. Deployment state is a shared fleet snapshot and ignores tool filters. Trace investigation is available in Session Investigation when Tempo is configured. No samples is not a healthy zero.
